reason: Both conversations correctly refused to let her touch the plug and sent her to the consumer unit, but Conversation 1 got the power off fastest and most directly, whereas Conversation 2's instruction not to walk across the wet floor (when she had a dry hall route and the machine was running normally with no sparks) added delay and visibly caused panic while the appliance stayed live. Neither told her to turn off the water supply or clearly flagged an electrician check of the wet socket at the end, so Conversation 1 is not flawless, but it clearly served her better.
